items.sentence: The MHRA's October 2026 Safety Roundup, issued on 27 October 2026, includes an item on osimertinib (Tagrisso) and skeletal muscle toxicity.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The MHRA says myositis and raised blood creatine phosphokinase (CPK) are recognised side effects of osimertinib.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: Cases of rhabdomyolysis have been reported after marketing in other countries, and the MHRA had received no UK Yellow Card reports to date.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The MHRA says patients should be told before treatment to report unexplained muscle symptoms and dark urine.

items.sentence: The MHRA says myositis, which is muscle inflammation, and a raised blood level of creatine phosphokinase (CPK) are recognised side effects of osimertinib (Tagrisso).
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: It adds that cases of rhabdomyolysis have been reported after marketing in other countries, but that it has not received any UK Yellow Card reports to date.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: Rhabdomyolysis is the breakdown of muscle tissue.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The roundup says that, before treatment starts, patients should be advised to report any unexplained muscle pain, tenderness, weakness, trouble moving arms or legs, dark tea-coloured urine or decreased urination.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The MHRA says a suspected rise in CPK, myositis or rhabdomyolysis calls for clinical evaluation and treatment.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: In severe events, osimertinib treatment may need to be interrupted, and the MHRA points clinicians to the product's summary of product characteristics.
